title: Tombstone
body:
"Wow, you can write your own obituary with ease! This solid chunk of rock can only be inscribed once."

Description

The Tombstone is an item that could be bought at Ghoulish Goods for 575 Candy. It can be inscribed once, resulting R.I.P [your Roblox username], a randomly generated obituary, and the date in which it was inscribed.

Trivia

The rarest variants are ones inscribed on October 7th, by developers, and by notable figures within the community.
